_about: Lecture-keyword inputs for app/tools/retrieval_eval.py, drafted 2026-11-09 to cover every subject (more for the larger ones) and the ways students type: slide wording, abbreviations, British spellings, technique names, named results, single terms, long syllabus pastes, informal wording with typos, and terms with several meanings. Written from course knowledge, not from the taxonomy labels.

styles.slide: terms as they appear on a lecture slide
styles.technique: a method or proof technique rather than a topic
styles.long: a pasted syllabus line with many terms
styles.ambiguous: a term with more than one meaning in the subject
